en.title: Midnight Desert Sweet Palette
en.premise: In the sleepless city's endless desert, a miraculous oasis appears—a café called "Dessert Dream" that offers sweet magic to soothe weary stomachs. I work there, a pastry‑perfectionist who’s a little clumsy. Travelers returning from work and the city’s insomniac residents bring their troubles, but a single bite of cake always sets things right. Eating, laughing, and a dash of sugar make tomorrow feel doable—this is a daily chronicle of those heart‑warming moments.

zh.title: 午夜沙漠甜点调色盘
zh.premise: 在这座不眠之城的沙漠里，奇迹般地矗立着一片绿洲——甜点咖啡厅「Dessert Dream」，用甜蜜的魔法拯救疲惫的胃。我是这里的店员，虽然对甜点要求苛刻，却有点笨拙。下班归来的旅人和失眠的城中人带来的烦恼，总能在一口蛋糕中得到解决！只要吃下去、笑出来，明天就能继续加油，这就是记录这份温暖日常的故事。
